title: SB2154 (2020 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2020/bills/SB2154_.HTM; sha256 0dda4825eb2c2998c1e7a0c3175b291daf855bbaa062457e3e31059bbdaf457c)
provenance.note: As-filed text (introduced). First quote leaves out the struck words 'which are designed for or capable of use with a pistol'. The bill also changes the penalty sentence so that possessing a banned magazine inserted in any firearm (not only a pistol) is a class C felony; otherwise a misdemeanor.

operative_text:
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-8): The manufacture, possession, sale, barter, trade, gift, transfer, or acquisition of detachable ammunition magazines with a capacity in excess of ten rounds is prohibited.
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-8): Detachable ammunition magazines with a capacity in excess of ten rounds may be acquired, possessed, and used by a law enforcement agency or duly authorized law enforcement officer for official purposes.
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-8): Any person violating subsection (a) or (b) shall be guilty of a class C felony and shall be imprisoned for a term of five years without probation.
